brief:
Israeli drone strikes and bombardments across Gaza killed at least seven Palestinians on Monday, according to Wafa news agency. Two of the dead were killed in a drone strike in the al-Mazraa area east of Deir el-Balah, while the circumstances surrounding the other five deaths were not detailed in initial reports.

The casualty toll came as Israeli military operations continued across the territory.
dek: Death toll from Israeli bombardments across Gaza rises to seven The death toll from Israeli bombardments across Gaza today has risen to seven after a drone strike killed two Palestinians in the al-Mazraa area east of Deir el-Balah, Wafa news agency reported.
title: Israeli strikes kill seven across Gaza in day of bombardments
